headline-medium.purpose: Card heads and the drawer wordmark.

title-medium.purpose: Sub-heads; with the mono face, single-glyph key caps.

title-small.purpose: Every row title and the selected session.

label-small.purpose: Key caps in narrow cells (zero tracking), small chips.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No drop shadows; surfaceTint equals the ground. Depth is the indigo dye ladder plus a 1dp edge.

shadows.name: horizon-line
shadows.value: 2px linear-gradient(to right, akane 0 alpha, #D2383F, #EE6A2E, #D2383F, akane 0 alpha) along the bottom edge
shadows.purpose: The signature: under the one current thing only.

shadows.name: horizon-glow
shadows.value: 14px linear-gradient(to top, akane 22% alpha, shu 10% alpha, transparent), scaled by risen
shadows.purpose: Sunset light fading up from the horizon line.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Switch track colour, content size changes.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: The wordmark's horizon on first launch.

motion.name: spring-rise
motion.purpose: The horizon rising under a selection, session or ready card; no overshoot, about 400ms.

motion.name: working-spin
motion.purpose: The working mark; still under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Horizon shown risen, switches snap, the working mark stops.

breakpoints.name: compact-key-cell
breakpoints.purpose: Below this cell width word keys step down to label-small.

breakpoints.name: full-key-row
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum cell for all columns to fit; else 7 keys fill the width and the rest scroll.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: AkaButton PRIMARY: the one akane action of a region; kokiake while pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; background: #D2383F; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1px; line-height: 20px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 64px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B83139; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #9E2A33; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: AkaButton SECONDARY: a kon container with the ai control line, so it never reads as text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; background: #131B36; color: #EEF0F5; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 64px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #4A66AA; border-radius: 10px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #1B2852; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { border-color: #2E4377; color: rgba(169,176,196,0.6); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Explicit destructive actions in Settings: tsutsuji fill, Ink Text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; background: #E95295; color: #0B0F1E; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Settings Row
components.description: AkaRow: a full-width row in its own kon tile, 56 minimum, the whole row the target.
components.html: Advanced
components.css: .ds-section { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; color: #A3B8EC; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 24px 16px 8px 20px; } .ds-row { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 3px 0; background: #131B36; border: 1px solid #2E4377; border-radius: 12px; color: #EEF0F5; text-align: left; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-row:active { background: #1B2852; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; } .ds-row-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; } .ds-row-sub { font-size: 12px; line-height: 17px; color: #A9B0C4; }

components.name: Segmented Selection
components.description: akaSelection: the selected sibling is konjō with the ai edge and its horizon risen.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #131B36; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-seg-item { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; flex: 1; min-height: 48px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #131B36; color: #EEF0F5; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #2E4377; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; } .ds-seg-item.ds-on { background: #1B2852; border-color: #4A66AA; } .ds-seg-item.ds-on::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 2px; height: 14px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(238,106,46,0.10), rgba(210,56,63,0.22)); } .ds-seg-item.ds-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(210,56,63,0), #D2383F, #EE6A2E, #D2383F, rgba(210,56,63,0)); }

components.name: Ubuntu Card
components.description: A large kon tile with the state mark plus words and one akane primary; its horizon rises once Ubuntu is ready.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #131B36; border: 1px solid #2E4377; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #EEF0F5; } .ds-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(210,56,63,0), #D2383F, #EE6A2E, #D2383F, rgba(210,56,63,0)); } .ds-card-head { font-family: 'Archivo SemiExpanded', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 29px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; } .ds-card-state { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 4px 0 16px; font-size: 12px; color: #A9B0C4; } .ds-mark-run { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #68BE8D; } .ds-card-btn { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; background: #D2383F; color: #FFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-card-btn:active { background: #9E2A33; } .ds-card-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: FluxSwitch: soft square track and thumb; on is akane with a white 22 thumb, off is kon with an ai edge and 16 ai thumb.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; padding: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 32px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #131B36; border: 1px solid #4A66AA; border-radius: 10px; transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 8px; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #4A66AA; border-radius: 6px; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track { background: #D2383F; border-color: #D2383F; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track .ds-thumb { left: 25px; width: 22px; height: 22px; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-track { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Extra Keys
components.description: Key caps on the pure-black bar: kon tiles with hanada edges, konjō while pressed, latched modifiers akane.
components.css: .ds-keys { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; background: #000000; } .ds-key { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; flex: 1; height: 44px; min-width: 40px; /* Termux density: the one exception to the 48 target */ background: #131B36; color: #EEF0F5; border: 1px solid #2E4377; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-key:active { background: #1B2852; border-color: #4A66AA; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A3B8EC; } .ds-glyph { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; } .ds-latched { background: #D2383F; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: transparent; } .ds-latched:active { background: #9E2A33; }

components.name: Status Marks
components.description: StatusMark: state by form first, colour second.
components.html: Running Idle Working Held Failed
components.css: .ds-marks { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #EEF0F5; font-size: 12px; } .ds-m { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-run { background: #68BE8D; } .ds-idle { border: 2px solid #A9B0C4; } .ds-work { border: 2px dashed #A3B8EC; animation: ds-spin 1.4s linear infinite; } .ds-held { border: 2px solid #F8B500; background: linear-gradient(to right, #F8B500 50%, transparent 50%); } .ds-fail { border: 2px solid #E95295; } .ds-fail::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -1px; width: 2px; height: 10px; background: #E95295; transform: rotate(45deg); } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-work { animation: none; } }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: AkaWordmark: Aka in akane, Terminal in shironeri, over the horizon.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo SemiExpanded', Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 30px; line-height: 36px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; color: #EEF0F5; } .ds-aka { color: #D2383F; } .ds-wordmark::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 2px; height: 14px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(238,106,46,0.10), rgba(210,56,63,0.22)); } .ds-wordmark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(210,56,63,0), #D2383F, #EE6A2E, #D2383F, rgba(210,56,63,0)); animation: ds-rise 720ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1); } @keyframes ds-rise { from { transform: scaleX(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-wordmark::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
AkaTerminal is the last light of the day over indigo night. 茜 akane, the madder red in the name, is the one accent and the horizon; the terminal is the night sky; the chrome around it steps up through the traditional indigo dyes. Every colour is a named Japanese traditional colour (`Iro`), and the app is black: the terminal and the extra-keys bar sit on pure black, every other screen on 墨 sumi, a black with an indigo cast.

The density is a tool used one-handed at night for long sessions. Nothing reads as loose text on the ground: every row, key, session, switch and secondary action sits in its own container (a tile in 紺 kon, edged in 縹 hanada or 藍 ai), and the one akane fill per region is the next step. The signature is the horizon: a 2dp line along the bottom of the one current thing, akane at its ends and 朱 shu at its brightest point, with sunset light fading up from it. It grows out from the centre and lifts with no overshoot. Reduced motion shows it risen.

Material 3 is underneath (drawer, dialogs, radio buttons, progress, snackbars, system Back) restyled with the dyes, a soft corner scale and one type family. The app forces the dark (night) scheme; the light (dawn) scheme, cool paper with akane deepened, is kept in `Theme.kt` so a later switch stays cheap. Dynamic (wallpaper) colour is off.
keyCharacteristics: Traditional colours only: sumi ground, indigo dyes for surfaces, akane the one accent, three state colours that travel with a mark.
Every control in a container; one akane primary per region.
The horizon under the one current thing, and nowhere else.
One family, Archivo: semi-expanded SemiBold for display and titles, normal width for reading; JetBrains Mono for code and keys.
Soft corners (6 to 24), one 1dp edge weight, no shadows.

rules.name: The Named Dye Rule
rules.body: Every colour is an `Iro` traditional colour or a scheme role built from one. New colours enter `Iro` and both schemes, never as a raw value in a screen. Screens read `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` or `AkaTheme.inks`.

rules.name: The One Akane Rule
rules.body: Akane is the action ink: one primary fill per screen region (and the latched keys, the on switch). Everything else is a kon container.

rules.name: The Form-First Rule
rules.body: Wakatake, yamabuki and tsutsuji never appear without their mark form or their words. Hue is the second signal.

rules.name: The Night Rule
rules.body: The chrome never outshines the terminal text: surfaces stay in the indigo dyes, shu stays inside the horizon, and the only large bright fill is the one akane primary.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo by width and weight, JetBrains Mono for code and keys. No third face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and section heads are sentence case at their role's tracking. No uppercase tracked labels above headings.

rules.name: The Dye Ladder Rule
rules.body: Lift a surface by stepping it one dye up the indigo ladder and giving it an edge, never with a shadow or tonal tint.

rules.name: The One Horizon Rule
rules.body: The horizon marks the one current thing in its context: the wordmark, the current session, the selected option or segment, the Ubuntu card once ready, the welcome terminal window. Never on idle siblings or as decoration.

dos: Do take every colour from `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` or `AkaTheme.inks`; new colours go into `Iro` and both schemes first.
Do put every control in a container: AkaRow, akaTile, AkaButton SECONDARY, never bare text.
Do give each region one akane AkaButton PRIMARY and make the rest SECONDARY.
Do mark the one current choice with akaSelection, so its horizon rises.
Do pair every state colour with a StatusMark form or plain words.
Do use the shape scale (6, 10, 12, 16, 24) and `FluxSpacing`, never raw dp for padding.
Do honour reduced motion: the horizon shows risen, switches snap.
Do set code, paths and commands in JetBrains Mono (`CodeStyle`).
donts: Don't use drop shadows, glows outside the horizon, glass or tonal elevation tints.
Don't draw the horizon on more than the one current thing, or use shu anywhere but the horizon and the icon's sun.
Don't set ai (#4A66AA) or hanada as text; use shiro-ai.
Don't put dark text on akane; it takes white. Yamabuki and tsutsuji take Ink Text.
Don't add uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't tint the terminal or the extra-keys bar; both stay pure black.
Don't use Rounded or Outlined icon sets, emoji or text glyphs as icons outside key caps.
